svg.title: Scene 66: Grover with four drawers: making the right answer loud
svg.desc: Five frames. 1, four drawers, one of which (drawer 10) holds the prize; a quantum register starts with equal amplitudes of 0.5 on each, so every drawer has probability 0.25. 2, the oracle flips the sign of the marked amplitude to −0.5; probabilities are unchanged. 3, the mean amplitude is now 0.25, and each amplitude is reflected about it. 4, after that inversion the marked drawer’s amplitude is 1 and the others 0, so measuring finds the prize with probability 1. 5, scaling: about (π/4)√N oracle queries for N items; four items is a teaching case where one round is exact; the table compares iterations and success probability for larger N with the classical average of N/2 looks.
svg.text: Not reading every drawer at once: interference
turns one quiet answer into a loud one.
